cmd:
set -e; cd /opt/weather-pipeline/repo; git fetch -q origin main || true; P=/opt/trading-bot/positions; git show FETCH_HEAD:bot/positions/pos.py > /tmp/pos_new.py; git show FETCH_HEAD:bot/positions/patch_claude_tab.py > /tmp/patch_claude_tab.py; systemctl stop pos-tracker; cp $P/positions.json $P/positions.json.bak_acct; cp $P/pos.py $P/pos.py.bak_acct; cp /tmp/pos_new.py $P/pos.py; python3 - <<"EOF"
import json
f="/opt/trading-bot/positions/positions.json"; ps=json.load(open(f))
for p in ps:
    if p["status"]=="open" and p.get("stake")==100.0: p["stake"]=6.0
    p.setdefault("lev",5)
json.dump(ps,open(f,"w"),ensure_ascii=False,indent=1)
print([(p["id"],p["stake"],p["lev"],p["status"]) for p in ps])
EOF
chown -R tbot:tbot $P; /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile $P/pos.py; systemctl start pos-tracker; sleep 2; systemctl is-active pos-tracker; python3 /tmp/patch_claude_tab.py /opt/trading-bot/classic; /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python -m py_compile /opt/trading-bot/classic/classic_panel.py && echo panel_compiles; su -s /bin/sh tbot -c "cd $P && /opt/trading-bot/venv/bin/python pos.py status"
